plan.title: Cart badge does not increase after adding a product
plan.description: Adding a product to the cart puts the item in the cart list, but the header cart counter does not reflect the new item count.
preconditions: buggy-shop is running at the target URL
Every execution starts from a fresh browser context, hence a new session with an empty cart

steps.description: The cart badge starts at Cart (0)
The cart list shows one keyboard after the add
The cart badge displays "Cart (1)" after adding one item

metadata.symptom: When I add a product to the cart, the cart counter at the top of the page doesn't go up.
